messages.title: We are looking for SFCC developers to join us!
messages.body: Join our amazing team of SFCC professionals with world-class automated processes and technology stack. We are eager to meet talented individuals who want to learn and improve.

messages.title: Commerce Cloud is going Headless with Vue Storefront! Join the VSF Summit!
messages.body: Ready to learn how to build headless commerce using a bodiless frontend? We have a ready-made solution for you! ForkPoint is giving a talk about the newly created connector between Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2C and Vue Storefront. Don't miss out.

messages.title: Learn about the state of Salesforce Online Retail in 2020
messages.body: The people at Salesforce have created a pretty comprehensive set of diagrams that show how online retail has been performing in the past year. Browse by countries and verticals, viewing the emerging trends in online e-commerce.

messages.title: Be more secure with OnePass
messages.body: We have created OnePass to help you stay secure and encrypt all your accounts with a single pass phrase. Go to the OnePass menu in settings to enable.

messages.title: Quickly locate content slots and assets on pages
messages.body: Quickly inspect any Content Assets and Slots on your Storefront by using the  Storefront Highlighter. Try it out by going to your Storefront and right-click on the page to reveal the DWithEase context menu, then click on the "Highlight Content" option.
